# Syslifters Handbook

> Syslifters is a specialized penetration testing company from Austria. Our specialisations are Microsoft-heavy enterprise environments (Active Directory), Microsoft Cloud (Entra ID, Azure, Microsoft 365) and web security.

## Table of Contents

- [👩‍💻 Secure Coding Policy](https://handbook.syslifters.com/organization/secure-coding.md): Secure coding requirements and OWASP checklist baseline for Syslifters projects.
- [📝 Information Security Policy](https://handbook.syslifters.com/organization/information-security-policy.md): Policy defining how Syslifters protects information and customer data.
- [🔥 Incident Response](https://handbook.syslifters.com/organization/incident-response.md): How Syslifters reports, contains, and notifies on security and privacy incidents, including CRA reporting for SysReptor and reptor.
- [About our organization](https://handbook.syslifters.com/organization.md): Overview of Syslifters’ organization, structure, and internal policies.
